notes: Torque = electromagnetic torque; friction/windage only in efficiency points.
Efficiency = machine only (no inverter, no gearbox). Inverter conduction loss scales with I_rms reported per point; f_sw is unchanged by pole changing.
Synchronous-machine inductances are saturated effective per-unit values (not FEA); WRSM 2p=4 values scaled from 2p=8 by k_w^2/p^2 on the magnetising part.
CPSR = n_const_power_end / n_base; n_base = highest speed with T >= 0.99 T_peak; constant power = P >= 0.95 P(n_base). Evaluated up to 9000 rpm.

WRSM.rotor_switching: 8 field coil groups, patterns as in Field Excitation/FE_MMF.m (P4): 2p=8 [1 -1 1 -1 1 -1 1 -1], 2p=4 [1 1 -1 -1 1 1 -1 -1]. Group A = coils 0,3,4,7 (fixed polarity), group B = coils 1,2,5,6 (reversed). REQUIREMENT: bipolar excitation of group B plus a unipolar channel for group A. Generic rotating-rectifier brushless exciters are unipolar (Krupp2015rotary, Stella2024excitation); Enes's own bipolar exciters exist at small scale: WPT dual-channel, +/-2.88 A, 118 W, 99 % rectifier efficiency (P1, Field Excitation/manuscript.pdf) and bipolar optical power transfer on a 10 kW 4/2-pole PC-WFSM (P2, draft). Treated as available; scaling to a ~4 kW truck field is an open item. Alternative without contactless hardware: 3 slip rings + stationary H-bridge.

P2_seed.note: Equal rated power at equal f_e in both modes implies the low-pole mode runs at 2x speed with ~0.5x torque. Used only as the scaling seed for the WRSM rotor-yoke choice (rotor yoke sized for the low-pole pattern).

WRSM.note: P1 sequence = free-wheel to zero + blanking + build-up (no torque from group B meanwhile; group A keeps partial field). Forced reversal needs a bipolar exciter with k x rated field voltage. tau_f from stored energy, saturation ignored (overestimates L_f).

IM_8_to_4_at_2100rpm.note: Under rotor-flux-oriented control with i_d forced to I_max. The decaying 2p=8 cage currents are spatially orthogonal to the 2p=4 field (no mean torque interaction); torque can ramp during the build. Simulator to confirm.

WRSM.gradual_transition_option: P4 pattern [1 k -k -1 1 k -k -1], k: 1 -> -1, sweeps the rotor field from 2p=8 to 2p=4 without a zero-field interval (Field Excitation/FE_MMF.m) - simulator target

winding.module_to_coils: module j -> coils j, j+16, j+32 (star, isolated neutral)
winding.prior_work_link: Same coil-group logic as Enes's 12-slot linearised 2-pole/4-pole patterns (Field Excitation/6-phase Induction Machine/Phase-Pole.pptx, slides 1-4): each coil group keeps its slot position and gets electrical angle p x (its mechanical position), so doubling p doubles every group's phase shift. Here generalised to 48 coils / 16 three-phase SPB modules.

a_low_speed_peak_torque_per_inverter_amp.unit_note: Nm per A rms of one module leg (all 48 legs carry the same current); same inverter for all

leader_requests_T03.b_inverter_kVA_vs_CPSR: see current_limit_sweep (S_inverter_kVA, CPSR, inverter_kVA_per_kW_base per machine)
